title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 3 Nov 1988 #116 Comic Book Aardvark-Vanaheim - Dave Sim
descriptionText: This is a collectible comic book titled "Cerebus Jaka’s Story 3 Nov 1988 #116" written and illustrated by Dave Sim for Aardvark-Vanaheim. It features the character Cerebus in a single issue format and is part of the Copper Age (1984-1991) era of US comics. The comic book is in English language and was published in America. It belongs to the genre of comics and is a great addition to any comic book collection.
